facts.claim: Traditional and recorded dates of the Roman Republic: overthrow of the monarchy c. 509 BC; First Punic War 264-241 BC; assassination of Caesar 15 March 44 BC; Battle of Actium 2 September 31 BC; Octavian proclaimed Augustus 16 January 27 BC.
Carthage was an ancient city in northern Africa, in what is now Tunisia; the Romans fought three wars against Carthage, known as the Punic Wars.
